{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative (sentiment < 0) or low (sentiment ≤ 0.33) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent high prices (last 5-7 days) when sentiment is positive (sentiment ≥ 0.5) to capture momentum.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 30-day average, reduce by 5-10% unless sentiment strongly bullish.",
    "Reduce forecast overshoot after sharp spikes (≥ 15% from prior peak) by 10-20% to avoid overreaction.",
    "For long-term horizons (>10 days), add a 2-5% downward bias to account for lagged market correction.",
    "When sentiment is neutral (0.00–0.33), use 30-day moving average as baseline, with ±5% volatility buffer.",
    "If true outcome is consistently below forecast (persistent underperformance), increase forecast lag by 1–2 days to align with market inertia."
  ]
}
